# @renai-labs/ren-tui-plugin

The Ren TUI plugin for [opencode](https://opencode.ai). It adds Ren behavior —
turn attribution/billing, command lockdown, and in-TUI Ren navigation — **only
when the current process is a Ren attach**. For any other opencode session it is
a guaranteed no-op: with the plugin installed globally, plain `opencode` behaves
exactly as if it were not installed (plan §3.5, the activation gate).

## Install

Run `ren tui install` (wires the plugin — and opencode itself — into your global
`opencode.json`), or add it to the `plugin` array by hand:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["@renai-labs/ren-tui-plugin@0.1.0"]
}
```

## Launch

The Ren CLI is the launcher — there is no standalone bin:

```bash
ren tui                  # interactive pod → project → session picker, then attach
ren tui attach <id>      # attach directly to a session
```

## How it works

The plugin sits behind a single activation gate. `ren tui` / `ren tui attach`
spawn `opencode attach <url>` with `REN_ATTACH=1` and the session/pod/project
context in the environment (never credentials — those come from your Ren profile
file). Inside the TUI, the plugin checks the gate first and returns early for any
non-Ren session.

## Versioning

The plugin is pinned to a specific opencode plugin API (`@opencode-ai/plugin/tui`)
via the repo-root `.opencode-version` — the same version the Ren sandbox fork
ships and that `ren tui` expects. `bun run sync-opencode-version` keeps the pin in
lockstep, and `prepublishOnly` fails on drift so a published build always matches
its target opencode.
